scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.test:regles: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-meridien "vitest run -c vitest.regles.config.mts"
scripts.emulateurs: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-meridien
scripts.test:fonctions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-meridien "tsx scripts/emulateurs/amorcer.ts && vitest run -c vitest.fonctions.config.mts"
scripts.e2e:emulateurs: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-meridien "npx tsx scripts/emulateurs/amorcer.ts && npx playwright test -c playwright.emulateurs.config.ts"
